top_signals.title: Japan confirms joint yen intervention with U.S., signaling readiness for more action
top_signals.summary: The joint intervention is the ​first since ‌2011, when the two countries took coordinated action to weaken the yen in the aftermath of the earthquake in eastern Japan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
